name: twilight_os
description: Twilight OS is a new modern, Experimental Unix-Like operating system & monolithic OS design with linux binary compatibility and MacOS like desktop experience

paragraphs: Twilight OS is a lightweight, Unix-like operating system written in Rust, designed for general-purpose computing, embedded systems, and detailed OS dev learning. It bridges the gap between educational kernels and usable systems by implementing advanced features like dynamic binary loading, a self-hosting C compiler, a custom filesystem, a from-scratch Wayland compositor, and a Linux-style timekeeping subsystem.
It currently targets x8664 (Limine boot, UEFI + BIOS).
features: Native C Compilation: Includes tcc (Tiny C Compiler) to compile and run C programs directly within the OS (tcc -run hello.c).
Dynamic Binaries: Full ELF shared object (.so) and dynamic executable support with a kernel ELF loader (PTLOAD, PTINTERP, auxv).
Scripting: tpy, a Python-subset interpreter, and bc, an arbitrary-precision calculator.
Shell & Utilities: oksh (pdksh-based shell) and tsh, plus coreutils-style cat, grep, ls, curl, vi, head/tail, wc, cp, mkdir, rm, touch, date, uname, and more.
Signals: Full POSIX signal delivery — rtsigaction, rtsigprocmask, rtsigsuspend, sigaltstack, kill/tgkill — with correct sleep interruption (-EINTR + remainder).
